PROMPT: Show current employment across levels area name, seasonally adjusted, industry title when Area Name is 'San Luis Obispo-Paso Robles-Arroyo Grande MSA', Seasonally Adjusted is 'Y'
QUERY_TEXT:
SELECT
  area_name.area_name AS area_name
  ,seasonally_adjusted.seasonally_adjusted AS seasonally_adjusted
  ,industry_title.industry_title AS industry_title
  ,current_employment
FROM ANALYTIC VIEW (
  USING caes_calf_employment_survey_av
    HIERARCHIES (
       area_name
       ,seasonally_adjusted
       ,industry_title)
  )
WHERE
  area_name.level_name = 'AREA_NAME'
  AND seasonally_adjusted.level_name = 'SEASONALLY_ADJUSTED'
  AND industry_title.level_name = 'INDUSTRY_TITLE'
  AND area_name = 'San Luis Obispo-Paso Robles-Arroyo Grande MSA'
  AND seasonally_adjusted = 'Y'
ORDER BY 
  area_name.area_name
  ,seasonally_adjusted.seasonally_adjusted
  ,industry_title.industry_title
